title: SubD topology
summary: How you build subdivision cages: quad flow, support loops, creases, poles and subdivision levels.

request.brief: Model one SubD hard-surface part with the Subdivision Surface modifier left live: a nozzle, a handle, a hull panel or a helmet piece. Use your normal holding loops or creases. Keep the cage you'd keep (don't apply the subdivision).
must_include: The low cage with a live Subdivision Surface modifier
At least one hole, opening or corner that needs controlling

questions.ask: How do you hold edges on SubD models?
Do you allow triangles or n-gons in SubD cages, and where?
